sent_bad: Based solely on `doc.txt`, the government's compliance strategies are set out mainly in **Chapter 2 ("Tackling non-compliance")**, supported by simplification and transparency measures in Chapters 1 and 3.
Taxpayers in temporary financial difficulty (including those affected by the pandemic) are excluded.

**7. Tackling offshore non-compliance (2.8)** – An HMRC stakeholder forum with representative bodies and agents, part of HMRC's "No Safe Havens" strategy, to reduce offshore non-compliance on non-UK income, gains and assets and to reduce and prevent international tax debt.
